[[Club Sport Emelec|Emelec]] successfully defended their title for their 12th overall. ==Format== The format for the season was played as in 2013 with the exception that the runner-up would not qualify to the [[Copa Sudamericana]].{{cite web|title=Marcha atrás! El campeonato 2014 se jugará con el formato del 2013|date=6 January 2014|url=http://www.ecuavisa.com/articulo/deportes/nacional/50196-marcha-atras-campeonato-2014-se-jugara-formato-del-2013|access-date=15 December 2014}} ==Teams== Twelve teams competed in the 2014 Serie A season, ten of which remained from the previous season. [[Club Deportivo Quevedo|Deportivo Quevedo]] and [[Club Social y Deportivo Macará|Macará]] were relegated to the [[Ecuadorian Serie B|Serie B]] after accumulating the fewest points in the [[2013 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A#Aggregate table|2013 season aggregate table]]. They were replaced by [[Centro Deportivo Olmedo|Olmedo]] and [[Mushuc Runa Sporting Club|Mushuc Runa]], the 2013 [[Ecuadorian Serie B|Serie B]] winner and runner-up, respectively. Olmedo was making a return to the Serie A after a one-year absence.
